name: smwsprites-customizable-screen-wrapping-platforms
title: Customizable Screen Wrapping Platforms
description:
Like the ones seen in Super Mario Bros. 1, the New Super Mario Bros. games, Ice Climber, and MegaMan 3, these screen-wrapping platforms comes with more Customizable options.
• It can go in 4 directions like down, up (vertical), left, or right (horizontal).
• It will come in different wide sizes like 32, 48, 64, or 80 pixels wide.
• It can move at different speeds between slower to faster.
• On/off blocks changes their opposite direction.
Requested by CalHal
